name: Recurring Invoice reports
whenToUse: Export a paginated report of recurring-invoice templates/schedules over a date range; use for subscriptions, not one-off invoices issued

queryParameters.name: per_page
queryParameters.description: The number of records to return for each request, default is 20

queryParameters.name: page
queryParameters.description: The page number to return for this request (when performing pagination), default is 1

fields.name: date_range
fields.description: The string representation of the date range of data to be returned

fields.name: date_key
fields.description: The date column to search between.

fields.name: start_date
fields.description: The start date to search between

fields.name: end_date
fields.description: The end date to search between
